sources.title: GitHub - krafton-ai/Raon-1-mini-preview: Raon-1 mini preview: a 30B-A4B ...
sources.snippet: Raon-1 mini is a 30B-A4B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model, designed and trained from scratch by KRAFTON AI. It demonstrates strong capabilities in Korean conversation and agentic tasks. As part of the Raon open model family, it is released under the Apache 2.0 license. Tip Want to try Raon-1 mini without setting anything up? Chat with it for free, for a limited time, in the Raon-1 mini ...

sources.title: Raon — Korean Intelligence for a More Open World
sources.snippet: Raon-1 mini Preview Small, yet powerful 30B A4B LLM Efficient inference. Exceptional agent capabilities With natural Korean and precise instruction following, it handles even complex tasks efficiently. To celebrate the release of KRAFTON's model, we're offering the API service free for a limited time.
